videos.title: Best Software Engineering Career Advice of 2025
videos.summary: Reaching the peak of your career early can be an unexpected trap that leads to burnout and existential crisis if you haven't defined what truly matters outside of work. videos.title: If I could give advice to myself when starting as a software engineer
videos.summary: After nearly two decades in tech, veteran engineer ThePrimeagen reveals the single biggest mindset trap that quietly stalled his early career: dismissing powerful tools as obsolete simply because they felt uncomfortable and had a steep learning curve. From bombing an interview by handwriting an entire Java program on a whiteboard when a single terminal command would have solved the problem, he illustrates how avoiding friction keeps programmers permanently held back. Watching this brutally honest reality check will save you years of ego-driven stagnation and fundamentally reshape how you approach mastering new skills.

videos.title: An AI Agent Got Its User Banned From Resy — Keycard, JPMorgan Chase & AAuth
videos.summary: If you are giving AI agents access to real-world APIs and enterprise databases, standard protocols like OAuth are a catastrophic security mismatch waiting to wipe your production environment. In this panel, the co-creator of OAuth alongside leading enterprise architects reveal how 'intent-based runtime authorization' and isolating an agent's reasoning from its execution credentials solves the rogue-agent dilemma. Watch this to learn the exact architectural blueprint required to unlock true autonomous capability without falling into the trap of human consent fatigue.

videos.summary: Shipping AI features on 'looks good to me' vibes is a ticking time bomb—a single prompt tweak can quietly break your entire agent without warning until a customer catches it. In this workshop, former npm executive Laurie Voss demystifies how to replace manual guesswork with automated evaluation pipelines using traces, deterministic code checks, and LLM judges. videos.title: Stop Chatting With Spreadsheets — Francesco Galletta & Felippe Felisola Caso, Monzo
videos.summary: Relying on raw AI prompts for high-stakes financial calculations is a dangerous trap, because stochastic models inevitably botch arithmetic and face zero real-world consequences when their numbers are wrong. In this masterclass, fintech engineers reveal how to move beyond fragile 'please make no mistakes' prompts by building an opinionated agent harness that combines LLM reasoning with deterministic code, verifiable audit receipts, and high-signal decision gates. If you want to stop babysitting AI chatbots and deploy automated financial analysts you can actually stake your reputation on, you cannot afford to miss this blueprint.
